Ehud Barak Jeffrey Epstein St. Thomas December 2014 — the flight ticket in another man's name

In December 2014, Epstein invited Ehud and Nili Barak to his Caribbean island: "Come to Carib?" Nili proposed American Airlines flight 1275 into St. Thomas on Dec 12 — Epstein approved the same night and had Lesley Groff coordinate it. Epstein's office then asked, in writing, whether to book the hotel under the name "Ehud Barak" — "or do you go by something else?" The room went under Nili's name.

The Baraks spent Dec 12–15 as Epstein's guests — lunch on his island, his staff running the logistics — while Epstein invited Larry Summers and Tom Pritzker for the same weekend ("ehud on island for weekend, come visit"). The visit is confirmed by Epstein's own staff email, EFTA00356456.

But the only flight itinerary for that trip anywhere in Barak's own email names a different passenger: COHEN/RONEN MR — flight 1275, JFK to St. Thomas, in on Dec 12 at 12:55 PM, out on Dec 14 via Miami, First class home to Tel Aviv (PNR 7HLSOQ). "Ronen Cohen" appears nowhere else in seven years of Barak's email — and the booking delivery, which names every other passenger the agency ever booked for this family, is headed "TEST."

The documents: Barak leak 18414 · 18310 · 18018 · 18243 · 19004 · 14998 — EFTA00356456 · EFTA02596796 · EFTA02346686. Full timeline, every document linked: grokarchivehub.com

Was "Ronen Cohen" a separate identity — or a man the archive simply cannot see? The receipts are public. Decide from the documents.

Leon Black Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA02730996, the Dechert memo.

January 22, 2021: Dechert LLP's independent investigation for Apollo's board, filed publicly with the SEC, puts the number in writing: "Black compensated Epstein for his work in amounts that were intended to be proportional to the value provided by Epstein. Those payments for work performed over the period 2012 through 2017 totaled $158 million." Itemized: $50M in 2013, $70M in 2014, $30M in 2015, a final $8M in April 2017 — paid to Epstein's Southern Trust Company — plus $30.5M in 2017 loans from Black's BV70 LLC.

July 24, 2023: Senate Finance Chairman Ron Wyden writes to Black (EFTA02731023): "you have refused to answer questions or provide documents related to payments you made to Epstein or substantiate how such payments were calculated or were compensation for services." (The later House subpoena fight is a separate proceeding — this reel stays on the Senate record.)

The gate, stated plainly: Dechert recorded the payments as compensation for tax and estate work and found no evidence tying them to Epstein's criminal activity. A payment record is not a crime finding. The documented fact is $158 million — and a Senate chairman on record that the calculation behind it was never substantiated.

9,131 documents in the DOJ releases name Black.

Read the memo: https://grokarchivehub.com
#GrokArchiveHub #EpsteinFiles #InvestigativeJournalism #LeonBlack #Apollo #WallStreet #DOJ #Documents

$10 million went into the charity. Outside charities got $325,000.

October 14, 2015: BV70 LLC credited $10 million to Gratitude America Ltd.'s Deutsche Bank money-market account (EFTA00080260, Exhibit A). In 2016, $8.775 million flowed back out — but reclassification matters: $8.45 million went to other accounts held by the same charity, not grants. Only $325,000 reached outside recipients ($100K Moskowitz Foundation; $225K Melanoma Research Alliance).

Later records: France's TRACFIN flagged a €50,000 wire, three SARs were referenced, and an IRS forensic accountant reviewed the accounts (EFTA00153569–571, EFTA00128841). Suspicion is not a finding — none of these documents, by themselves, establish a crime.

Dechert's SEC-filed review separately identifies Leon Black as the donor of a $10 million October 2015 donation. Full 28-row ledger: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/gratitude-america-money-trail-2015-2019

Bill Gates Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA02730265, the 2013 "Points" memo.

When Gates's science adviser Boris Nikolic left bgC3, Gates's lawyer Larry Cohen sent the draft separation terms to Jeffrey Epstein: "Wanted to get these to you for input." The terms: mutual non-disparagement, no legal claims against Gates, his family, the foundation, or bgC3 — ever. Signed: Bill Gates. Nikolic's own edit the next morning: move the date, and rewrite the point about Epstein "helping me find a job."

2,620 documents in the DOJ releases name Bill Gates. This one is his office's paperwork inside Epstein's inbox.

Elon Musk Jeffrey Epstein email — EFTA02338119, December 2013.

Musk, from his own account, Dec 13, 2013: "Will be in the BVI/St Bart's area over the holidays. Is there a good time to visit?" Epstein: "Anytime. I will be there 28–7th." Musk, next day: "Is there a day/night that you would particularly recommend within those dates?"

The email does not show whether the visit happened. Musk has said publicly that he declined to visit Epstein's island. The archive publishes the document — and the limit of what it proves.

"Elon Musk" appears in 1,058 documents in the releases. This is the one he wrote himself.

Mark Zuckerberg Epstein files — 385 mentions. Contact: zero.

No email, no meeting, no call: across the DOJ releases, the Barak leak, and House Oversight, no document shows Zuckerberg communicating with Epstein. The mentions are other people's paper — a 2019 donation pitch to Epstein citing Zuckerberg's $3 million Breakthrough Awards as the model (EFTA00034221), and a Davos conference pitch name-checking him (EFTA02262778).

Gates has paperwork. Musk has an email. Zuckerberg has mentions. A name in the files is not a relationship — and the archive publishes the difference.

Larry Summers Jeffrey Epstein Harvard — EFTA02239873, EFTA02239649.

March 2018, a decade after Epstein's guilty plea, his office is arranging a Harvard Sunday around Larry Summers: "Jeffrey is planning a trip up to Harvard this Sunday March 25th… might Larry be around and available to meet with him?" Groff's memo the next day tracks Summers's flight back from Beijing so the schedule can bend around him. Epstein's Harvard millions landed while Summers was the university's president (2001–2006). Nine months earlier, a travel itinerary titled "Vancouver -> Island" went out with Hoffman's name on it. June 23, 2015: Epstein's assistant Lesley Groff writes to Epstein, "Do you want me to give Stephen Hawking's email address to Steven Pinker?" Forwarded inside the thread: physicist Lawrence Krauss handing it over — "I don't normally give out email addresses, even to friends... but I guess since Jeffrey flew stephen on a plane it is ok."

Ghislaine Maxwell Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA02332402, her own email.

September 6, 2002: James Attaway is traveling to Palm Beach to meet Jeffrey Epstein. The person who re-routes his trip is Ghislaine Maxwell, writing as "G. Max": "James is there any chance of changing the schedule again - instead of coming in on Mon can you come to Palm Beach on Sunday. Can you let me know so that this can be organized ASAP. My new Asst is called Helen. Thank you — G" His reply the same evening: no problem — her assistant has him arriving West Palm Beach 9:41am Sunday, "a driver will be waiting to pick me up."

A second document: the seized Palm Beach household binder (EFTA00007893) lists "Mr. Jeffrey Epstein / Ms Ghislaine Maxwell" as the two principals at every property — New York, Palm Beach, Zorro Ranch, Little St. James, Paris, London.

That's the documented Maxwell — the operating officer of the household, in her own hand. What she was convicted of, a jury decided in 2021. These documents show how the house ran.

Jean-Luc Brunel Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA01972778, the MC2 account email.

December 5, 2012: the MC2 modeling agency's office sends an account statement — to close an account — to Richard Kahn, Jeffrey Epstein's personal accountant. Kahn resolves a withheld-check discrepancy in writing ("you will be getting back 4,380 of the 5,000 mistakenly withheld from your check"), with Brunel and Epstein both copied. Epstein's financial office sat inside MC2's payment plumbing.

A second document, in Brunel's own words (EFTA00962798, June 2013): he asks Jeffrey's permission to repaint the apartment Epstein provided him — "I have never asked anything have always been very thankful for what Jeffrey is doing." Epstein forwards it to staff with one word: "follow up."

What these documents establish is business entanglement and patronage. What they do not mention is conduct — that record lives in court filings and allegations, and this archive keeps the two separate.

Alan Dershowitz Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA00352969, Epstein's own itinerary.

Thursday, February 12, 2015: Lesley Groff writes to Epstein, "Working on your itinerary for today... Rich Joslin and Alan Dershowitz both needed to meet you earlier... Alan is confirmed..." The schedule for the day Epstein flew in from St. Thomas ends: "4:00pm Appt w/Alan Dershowitz." Eight months later, October 14, 2015, the office schedule again lists "5:00pm Appt w/Dershowitz" (EFTA00338082).

The full record, carried both ways: Dershowitz was on Epstein's defense team for the 2007–08 Florida case — a documented professional relationship. The allegation that made him famous in this story was withdrawn: in November 2022 Virginia Giuffre dropped her lawsuit against him, saying she may have made a mistake identifying him. He has always denied any wrongdoing.

A schedule is a plan, not proof a meeting occurred — the archive publishes it as a plan. What it documents is scheduled access in 2015, in Epstein's own office paper.

Bill Richardson Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA00014374, the prosecutors' own memo.

August 18, 2019: an SDNY prosecutor writes up a call with Bill Richardson's counsel about the allegation unsealed days earlier in the Giuffre civil papers. The memo's read of that deposition: Richardson "was ordered to, but doesn't appear to say that anything actually happened." And: prosecutors did not intend to subpoena him or request an interview — "there are not specific allegations that we need to hear his side of at this time."

The releases do document a phone channel — in January 2017 Epstein's scheduler relayed that Richardson would call Epstein in ten minutes (EFTA02662212). Contact is documented. The allegation itself remained an allegation: Richardson denied it, he was never charged, and he died in 2023.

869 documents in the DOJ releases name Richardson — most are duplicated tips and news compilations.

videos.title: Ehud Barak's Island Weekend — and the Flight Ticket in Another Man's Name
videos.author: Grok Archive Hub
videos.description:
In December 2014, Jeffrey Epstein invited former Israeli prime minister Ehud Barak and his wife Nili to his Caribbean island. The public story has always been that Barak's island visit was brief and all business. The documents tell a longer story.
"Come to Carib?" — Epstein, 2:27 AM, December 6, 2014.
Told entirely from the primary record — the Baraks' own email, Epstein's office files from the DOJ release — this video walks the full timeline: the invitation, Nili's flight proposal (American Airlines 1275 into St. Thomas, Dec 12), Epstein's same-night approval, his office asking in writing whether to book the hotel under the name "Ehud Barak" — "or do you go by something else?" — the room booked under Nili's name instead, four days hosted on St. Thomas with lunch on the island, simultaneous invitations to Larry Summers and Tom Pritzker, and the staff farewell: "Mr. Epstein truly enjoyed this weekend."
And then the anomaly: the only flight itinerary for that trip anywhere in Barak's own email names a different passenger — COHEN/RONEN MR, on the Baraks' exact flight, arriving at the exact proposed minute, First class home to Tel Aviv (PNR 7HLSOQ). "Ronen Cohen" appears nowhere else in seven years of Barak's email, or in 1.38 million released DOJ documents. This video presents both readings of that ticket — and labels them as readings. The documents are the story.
